items.title: Savita Oil hits record high of Rs 862.80, up 200% year to date
items.text: Whalesbook reports Savita Oil Technologies touched a record Rs 862.80 on the BSE, up 200% year to date and 25% in September while the Sensex fell 5.6%. It cites Q1 FY27 revenue of Rs 1,513 crore and PBT of Rs 387 crore. The article attributes growth to demand for transformer oils used in power grids and data centres, not to liquid-cooling fluids. Savita has not disclosed data-centre coolant revenue, so the re-rating is not yet evidence of fluids traction.
